title: Supplier report
intro: How many business days new suppliers take from invitation to approval (KPI G-7), the applications waiting past their due time, and the suppliers whose documents expired. The figures come from the system, not from AI.
moduleOff: This organization has not switched on the supplier module, so this report is not available yet.
noneYet: No application approved in this period yet

median.title: Median business days from invitation to approval (G-7)
median.hint: Business days on the organization’s calendar (1 day = one working day), one decimal; with an even count, the lower middle value. New suppliers approved in this period only.

approved.title: Applications approved in this period ({count})
approved.caption: New supplier applications approved in this period, with the business days from invitation to approval
approved.emptyTitle: No application approved in this period
approved.emptyHint: Try a longer period: a new supplier often takes weeks from invitation to approval.

overdue.title: Applications past their due time ({count})
overdue.intro: Applications the supplier has not finished that the system passed to procurement because they are past due, as of now (whatever the period).
overdue.caption: Applications past their due time
overdue.emptyTitle: No application is past its due time
overdue.emptyHint: An application shows here once it is past the time the system passes it to procurement.

expired.title: Suppliers with an expired required document
expired.intro: Suppliers with at least one required document expired as of today, by supplier category.
expired.caption: Suppliers with an expired required document, by category
expired.emptyTitle: No supplier has an expired required document
expired.emptyHint: When a supplier’s required document expires, its category shows here.

export.title: Export
export.hint: An Excel file of the applications in the table above, for the same period and scope, with the file’s checksum.
